## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` has zero errors
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes, and test titles name the requirement they prove
- [ ] New pages have an accessibility test and strings in English and Hindi
- [ ] No secrets in code, keys only in `.env`
- [ ] No unverified amounts, deadlines or URLs added
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour changed
